Select local hardware architecture preset through hardware card
Set llama.cpp mode, full GPU layers, batch/ubatch 512, context 768, parallel 1, tiering disabled via controls
Set request 512 prompt and 128 output tokens via request table
Export original frontend scenario; edit only explicitly recorded runtime fields in auxiliary JSON; import it through frontend file chooser and backend normalization
Validate and export using frontend buttons

remaining_partial_costs: disabled sampler and EOS logit-bias overhead

scenario.message: 常驻模型权重按 2 个组件上的物理 TP/PP/EP 分片校验容量；其中 762.8 MiB 为显式详细放置
